releaseStatus.reason: No C6 or C7 model has completed the full approval workflow. A release-ready manifest requires four independently approved entries: C6 classification, C6 detection, C7 classification, and C7 detection. Every entry must include all required evidence and approver sign-off under FR-LIC-004 or FR-LIC-014. Release gates G-DEP-07 and G-DEP-08 therefore remain closed, and models stays empty until SPI-11 through SPI-17 establish legal, provenance, parity, platform-support, and quality evidence.
